name: BDD: ERL: Informatica: Check two addresses are suggested
summary:
User Story: GWA-22267

Product: Office

Brand: RC EU(France,Germany,Netherlands,Ireland,Singapore)/AU/EU/UK/Avaya(France/Netherlands/Ireland/AU)/ATT UB(France,Austria, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Spain,Belguim)/BT

Account type(/s): Admin
preconditions:
Entry point(/s): 

  1. Create unconfirmed admin account with SP 1075=2
  2. Add cookie "force_erl_validation" = 1 and Two suggested  addresses from ES-16907 before opening activation link
  3. Proceed till ERL step

Notes:

  • To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

steps.name:
1. Click "Edit" button
  2. Click "Update my location info" button
steps.expectedResult:
The following pop-up is displayed:

Title: "Confirm your address"

Text: "We found multiple addresses that match the information that you entered.  Please check the suggestions below and choose the correct address."


The 2 addresses from cookie configuration are displayed next to radiobuttons.

Buttons:

  • "Back"
  • "Continue" - disabled

steps.name: Pick one address from the list and click "Continue"
